sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly who shall be elected by the Members from among Members of Parliament. (2) A Minister, Deputy Minister or a person holding any other office prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament for purposes of this Article shall not be eligible for election as Deputy Speaker. (3) Members shall elect a Deputy Speaker at the following times: (a) when Parliament first meets after a General Election, or as soon as possible thereafter; and (b) at the first sitting of Parliament after the office of Deputy Speaker becomes vacant for any reason other than dissolution of Parliament, or as soon as possible thereafter. (4) The Deputy Speaker shall cease to be Deputy Speaker and shall vacate the office upon the occurrence of any of the following: (a) if he ceases to be a Member of Parliament; (b) if any circumstance arises which, if he were not Deputy Speaker, would render him ineligible for election or cause him to lose qualification for election as Deputy Speaker; or (c) if he is removed from office by a resolution of the National Assembly.
vifungu: (1) There shall be a Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly who shall be elected by the Members from among Members of Parliament.
(2) A Minister, Deputy Minister or a person holding any other office prescribed by a law enacted by Parliament for purposes of this Article shall not be eligible for election as Deputy Speaker.

(3) Members shall elect a Deputy Speaker at the following times: (a) when Parliament first meets after a General Election, or as soon as possible thereafter; and (b) at the first sitting of Parliament after the office of Deputy Speaker becomes vacant for any reason other than dissolution of Parliament, or as soon as possible thereafter.

(4) The Deputy Speaker shall cease to be Deputy Speaker and shall vacate the office upon the occurrence of any of the following: (a) if he ceases to be a Member of Parliament; (b) if any circumstance arises which, if he were not Deputy Speaker, would render him ineligible for election or cause him to lose qualification for election as Deputy Speaker; or (c) if he is removed from office by a resolution of the National Assembly.
